home.title: All your runs, in one place
home.body: Log the seed, character and key items of every run. Search for seeds with the synergy you want to play and vote for the most destructive ones.

design.intro: The site's base components. All plain CSS.
design.seedHint: 8 characters, no I, O, U or 5
